summary: Evaxion A/S filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing new biomarker data from its phase 2 trial of personalized cancer vaccine EVX-01 in advanced melanoma. The data, showing neoantigen-specific T-cell responses detectable ex vivo and reinforcing the predictive performance of the AI-Immunology platform, is to be presented in oral and poster sessions at the SITC 2026 Annual Meeting in Phoenix. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. This is a routine clinical pipeline disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation; watch for partnering commentary rather than deal terms.
